[LUNI.8.7.1] **A `::<unit>` cast carries the target unit's dimension.** The
dimension of `x::<unit>` is the dimension of `<unit>`. The result must
participate in same-dimension auto-conversion ([LUNI.8.1]), cross-dimension
rejection ([LUNI.8.2]), the bare-number rule ([LUNI.8.3]), and the dimensioned × dimensioned refusal
([LUNI.8.4]).
